mckone-2007.citation: McKone, Walker and Weeks (2007), Full-Water Column Currents Near the Sigsbee Escarpment (91–92 degrees W Longitude) and Relationships with the Loop Current and Associated Warm- and Cold-Core Eddies, MMS 2007-056.
mckone-2007.access: Original government report acquired. PDF page 30 / printed page 20 actual pixels reviewed for the November WCE K interaction current diagnostics; native cm/s retained. Figure 11 date is context, not exact current sample time.

hamilton-2003-k-alias.citation: Hamilton et al. (2003), Deepwater Observations in the Northern Gulf of Mexico from In-Situ Current Meters and PIES, Volume II: Technical Report, MMS 2003-049.
hamilton-2003-k-alias.access: Original government report acquired. PDF page 24 / printed page 14 actual pixels reviewed for the explicit Kinetic / Eddy K alias and 2000 phase history. This is alias context, not an independent measurement of the November LSU site currents.

association_basis: Both reports describe a weak 2000 anticyclone, summer mooring influence and subsequent interaction with the Loop Current/cyclones.
Shared regional event sequence includes Juggernaut/J before K and the 2001 major ring after K.
source_case_association.date_conventions: 2003 report discusses a May precursor; 2007 report gives mid-June detachment. Neither convention is silently reconciled.

accepted_diagnostics.support: near-surface reached value; exact depth unspecified

event_context: First two weeks of November 2000, LSU Sigsbee mooring between WCE K and a cyclone; source Figure 11 is labelled 3 November.

reviewed_size_gaps.name: Arnold / Slim Chance
reviewed_size_gaps.decision: No supported Arnold alias found for its numeric historical ring sizes; leave them unassigned. Generic major-ring sizes are not individual estimates.

reviewed_size_gaps.name: Nansen / Odessa
reviewed_size_gaps.decision: The report names Odessa in an N/O merger. No explicit Nansen alias established for N; merged footprint dimensions are not assigned to either individual.

reviewed_size_gaps.name: Nautilus II
reviewed_size_gaps.source: Saenz-Avalos (2024), UABC MSc thesis, Distribucion y posible origen de hidrocarburos ... XIXIMI IV-VI (2015-2017)
reviewed_size_gaps.decision: Body names western Nautilus II, but Figure 6 groups Nautilus/Nautilus II and is modified from Pulster et al. 2020. Its shared contour is not assigned as an individual child width.

reviewed_size_gaps.name: Nautilus II
reviewed_size_gaps.source: Linacre et al. (2019), DOI 10.1029/2019JC015103, indexed primary article
reviewed_size_gaps.decision: Figures 2 and 5 group Nautilus and Nautilus II. Shared hydrographic criteria and cruise averages do not supply an individual secondary measurement. Original PDF not acquired.

other_access_observations: Haley et al. OCEANS 2023 original MIT PDF: normal HTTPS and HTTP requests timed out; no PDF accepted.
BOEM-hosted Sigsbee PDF local request returned HTTP 403; original obtained from GovInfo mirror.
measurements_not_admitted: Generally below 20 cm/s in an earlier Kinetic phase is not a strict universal upper bound.
January 2001 60 cm/s is associated with mixed LC/LCFE activity, not isolated Kinetic motion.
Warm water through 600 m is not eddy thickness.
